entries.title: Show HN: Web page that parses and explains the label on a bike tire
entries.author: moasda
entries.current_title: Show HN: Web page that parses and explains the label on a bike tire
entries.excerpt: History: Last year I had to replace the tire on my bike, and I was surprised how difficult it was to find a suitable new tire. There were a lot of numbers written on the casing, so I googled what they meant. In the end I was successful, but I didn't want to do the same work again for the next bike after I've forgotten the details. So I wrote this website. Technically, the web page is kept very simple, no frameworks, no templates, no website builder. It uses HTML5, CSS and Jav
entries.guide_zh: 更换自行车轮胎太难选，作者制作网页解释胎壁标签上的数字。
